subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA redlines and SCCs — next sprint
body:
From: Sara Milton <sara.milton@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + DPA redlines (first pass)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the call this week. I attached Greenline's redline to your DPA (Greenline_DPA_redline_v3.docx) and a quick annotated Order Form with a request to clarify the export controls / SCCs delegation for subprocessor flows. High-level asks:

- Can Redwood confirm whether the SCCs delegations in Appendix A cover a) cross-border subprocessors used by third-party embeddings provider, and b) the fallback routing to Dedicated in the EU?
- We flagged a deletion request clause that we think needs operational detail (retention timelines + deletion verification).
- Pricing/credits ask: If a TIA assessment is required for certain locales, Greenline requests a one-time engineering effort credit.

We'd like to run a second pass with legal on Tuesday. Tom (cc'd) will run procurement side. Please let me know who on Redwood legal I should expect.

Best,
Sara Milton
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Greenline Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Greenline DPA redlines — initial triage

Laura / Ben —

Sara from Greenline sent a v3 redline and an Order Form with SCCs/delegation questions. Quick triage:

1) Greenline wants confirmation that our SCCs + delegation matrix cover third-party embedding providers (they named Embeddix in their doc) and that Dedicated fallback routing doesn't create a transfer gap.
2) They want an explicit deletion verification flow and retention timelines in the DPA.
3) They requested a one-time credit for TIA assessment work.

Can legal confirm which of these are negotiable vs. standard Redwood positions? I suggest:
- Laura, propose exact language for the deletion verification and retention table we can accept.
- Ben, prepare a commercial note on a limited engineering credit (range $5k-$20k) and what triggers it.

We aim to have a consolidated response back to Greenline by Tue 07/13 EOD PST.

Thanks — Karthik
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

-----

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenline DPA redlines — legal pass v1

Karthik / Ben —

I've completed a legal pass on the Greenline redline. High-level: most redlines are either acceptable with narrow edits or require alternative protective language. Key points below and attached the SCCs-delegation-matrix.xlsx we built to show mapping.

- SCCs / Subprocessor delegation: We can confirm coverage for third-party embedding providers if they are listed as subprocessors in the Order Form or a referenced schedule. Proposed fix: add an explicit clause in Section 3.2: "Subprocessor Delegation: Redwood will ensure that any third-party embedding or vectorization providers used for Greenline data are bound by equivalent SCC obligations; Redwood will list such subprocessors in Schedule X and update within 30 days of engagement."

- Dedicated fallback routing: operationally this is not a cross-border transfer if Dedicated is provisioned in the EU region. We will add a line in the Transfer Impact Addendum noting the region-bound routing policy and that fallback to other regions will only occur under outage conditions with notice.

- Deletion verification: we suggest a pragmatic table for retention + verification:
  * Customer primary data: retention as per Order Form; deletion within 30 days of request; audit token returned within 14 days.
  * Aggregated/ephemeral cache: 24 hours default, can be extended by agreement.
Proposed clause language attached in the doc.

- TIA credit: commercial ask — this is a sales call. My legal view: we can accept a one-time engineering credit tied to a scoping validation (max $15,000). Any credit should be reflected as an Order Form line item (Credit: "TIA Evaluation Credit").

Next steps: Ben, confirm commercial range and whether you want to offer credit as a credit or a rate-limited support bucket. Karthik, I'll prep a tracked-changes DPA and a short summary memo for Greenline legal. Aim to have the memo + docs by Tue morning so Greenline can review ahead of a call.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SCCs-delegation-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 8KB)
Attachment: DPA_language_proposals.docx (document, 4KB)

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Milton <sara.milton@greenlinehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + DPA redlines — commercial response

Sara —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We are open to offering a one-time TIA evaluation credit. Options: $10k credit applied to the first invoice, or a time-boxed engineering engagement of up to 40 hours covered by Redwood. Which is preferable from procurement's perspective?

Also confirm: if we list Embeddix as a subprocessor, we'll need the contractual add-on approved by them (we'll handle the outreach). We propose to list subprocessors in Schedule X and include a quarterly notification cadence.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call Tue if that helps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the feedback and the papers. Quick summary and ask:

1) Legal (Laura) will send a tracked-changes DPA + short memo by tomorrow morning (7/14).
2) Sales (Ben) will propose one of the two credit options in the HubSpot deal record (GF-2026-1147) and confirm which we offer in the Order Form.
3) Ops (Marissa) — please prepare the scheduled list of subprocessors for Schedule X and confirm Embeddix outreach status by EOD Friday.
4) Sara / Greenline — please confirm whether the $10k credit or 40-hour covered engagement is preferred; also confirm whether Embeddix is acceptable as listed subprocessor or if Greenline requires an alternate.

I'll schedule a 30-minute call Tue 7/14 10:00am PT if that works for everyone — invite to follow. If procurement needs an earlier exec sign-off on credit, please flag.

Regards,
Karthik
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
